CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.zz_ec_sp_editions (
        lad24cd varchar(9) NOT NULL,
        vintage text NOT NULL,
        edition integer NOT NULL,
        value integer,
        release_label text,
        published_date date,
        source_file text,
        source_sha256 text,
        supersedes integer,
        loaded_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
        PRIMARY KEY (lad24cd, vintage, edition)
    )

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.zz_ec_sp_editions_immutable() RETURNS trigger AS $f$
    BEGIN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'zz_ec_sp_editions is append-only: % is not permitted', TG_OP;
    END
    $f$ LANGUAGE plpgsql

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER zz_ec_sp_editions_immutable
        BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON public.zz_ec_sp_editions
        FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.zz_ec_sp_editions_immutable()

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER zz_ec_sp_editions_no_truncate
        BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.zz_ec_sp_editions
        FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION public.zz_ec_sp_editions_immutable()

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.zz_ec_sp_editions_file_checks (
        id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
        vintage text NOT NULL,
        source_file text NOT NULL,
        file_sha256 text NOT NULL,
        outcome text NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('new', 'unchanged', 'revised', 'live-missing')),
        edition integer,
        checked_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    )

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.zz_ec_sp_file_checks_immutable() RETURNS trigger AS $f$
    BEGIN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'zz_ec_sp_editions_file_checks is append-only: % is not permitted', TG_OP;
    END
    $f$ LANGUAGE plpgsql

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER zz_ec_sp_file_checks_immutable
        BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON public.zz_ec_sp_editions_file_checks
        FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.zz_ec_sp_file_checks_immutable()

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER zz_ec_sp_file_checks_no_truncate
        BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.zz_ec_sp_editions_file_checks
        FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION public.zz_ec_sp_file_checks_immutable()
